items.title: Markdown profile views are stale

items.fix: P1.2 re-render views and add Docs Check to CI-run validation.

items.title: Architecture review evidence is stale
items.evidence: Invoke-V3Architecture.ps1 -Mode Review on a copy of analysis/ifx fails: 'Inventory evidence is stale; rerun Analyze: src/ApiHost/IFX.ApiHost/IFX.ApiHost.csproj'. review-profile/project-map.json, tech-stack.json and rules/ differ from profiles/ifx; architecture-review.json records decision needs-review.

items.title: DEPLOYMENT procedure fails as documented
items.evidence: V3_ifx/DEPLOYMENT.md lines 21-24 run Analyze, Review and Docs Check as the evidence refresh step; Review and Docs Check fail on the baseline (DRIFT-01, DRIFT-02). Test-IFXTools.ps1 and Test-V3ArchUnit.ps1, listed in DEPLOYMENT, also fail (DRIFT-06, DRIFT-07).
items.whyUndetected: Documented manual procedure, not executed in CI.
items.fix: P1.2 after DRIFT-01/02/06/07 are fixed, re-run the documented procedure and correct DEPLOYMENT.

items.title: File count claim is wrong
items.evidence: architecture/IFX-MIGRATION.md states templates/ifx-layerguard contains 173 tracked files; the baseline tree has 174.
items.fix: P1.2 replace the count with a reference to inventory.json / duplicates.json.

items.title: SourceConfig area matches no files
items.evidence: profiles/ifx/project-map.json area SourceConfig uses pathPattern 'src/*'; the baseline has no files directly under src/ (only directories), so the area is dead and its focusedCommand ifx-layerguard is never suggested.
items.fix: P1.2 remove or correct the area (project-map change; monotonicity rules do not exist yet, so the change is reviewed manually).

items.title: ci/jobs.json is never validated
items.evidence: No PowerShell, C# template or workflow reads docs/guards/V3_ifx/ci/jobs.json (git grep); it can diverge from the workflow and ruleset without failing any check.
items.fix: P1.3 read-only verifier: workflow job names <-> ci/jobs.json <-> ruleset (strict).

items.title: Historical-integrity trigger declaration differs from the workflow
items.evidence: ci/jobs.json declares v3-historical-integrity trigger 'history-change-schedule-manual'; the workflow job has no if/path filter and runs on every pull_request, push to main, schedule and workflow_dispatch. Verified.
items.fix: P1.2/P1.3 make the declaration match the always-run behavior (required check must not stay pending, Plan 06 §10.3).

items.title: Package tests outside CI are broken
items.evidence: Test-IFXTools.ps1 fails on DRIFT-01 (it runs Docs Check). Test-V3ArchUnit.ps1 fails with NU1008 because its fixture under artifacts/ inherits the root central package management (build-inheritance.json). Neither test is run by any CI job (call-graph.json notCiReachable).
items.fix: P1.2 fix Test-IFXTools via DRIFT-01; Test-V3ArchUnit is resolved by the P5 package-local build baseline (D14). Adding them to CI is decided with the TCB validation suites (P2.6).

items.title: Specialized scripts not reachable from any entry
items.evidence: Test-Plan04Documentation.ps1, Test-Plan04Phase0Baseline.ps1, Test-Plan04Phase1Inventory.ps1 and Test-Plan04Phase2Audit.ps1 are not called by Invoke-IFXSpecialized or any test, tech-stack command or document (call-graph.json exposure unreferenced).
items.fix: P1.2 decide wire-up or retirement (retirement is a protected deletion and waits for P4).

items.title: Canonical V3 package is not exercised by CI
items.evidence: No CI job invokes any docs/guards/V3 executable (call-graph.json v3PackageCiReachable = 0); only V3_ifx copies run. V3 lacks the V3_ifx Diff hardening (v3-divergence.json).
items.fix: P3 merges hardening into V3 and adds V3 tests to validation; P7 switches V3_ifx to the V3 engine.
